crossRefs.note: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on…
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel…

parallels.note: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

translations.web: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
translations.bsb: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
